# nix.dev — Official Nix Documentation

> Official documentation hub for the Nix ecosystem: tutorials, guides, reference links, and best practices for reproducible builds and declarative system configuration.

## Core Sections

- [Tutorials](https://nix.dev/tutorials/): Step-by-step introductions to Nix, Nixpkgs, and NixOS.
- [Guides](https://nix.dev/guides/): Practical recipes and troubleshooting guides.
- [Reference](https://nix.dev/reference/): Pinning Nixpkgs, Nix manuals, and glossary.
- [Concepts](https://nix.dev/concepts/): Core principles of the Nix language and store.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for deterministic LLM and RAG ingestion.
